description: Veiligheid voorlopers is a dataset listed in Infrabel open data portal, an open data portal of a railway infrastructure manager, published or maintained by Infrabel. Veiligheidsincidenten die tot ongevallen kunnen leiden. Dit zijn de Voorlopers ISI (Infrabel Safety Indicators) die Infrabel gebruikt om de spoorveiligheid te evalueren en zijn doelstellingen te bepalen. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Veiligheid. Its keywords are Incidenten, Seinvoorbijrijding, Spoorlopers. The portal shows 2024-02-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-infrabel-open-data-portal.
